tasks.title: Stop /sw.js 404 console error on every screen
tasks.brief: index.html registers '/sw.js?v=3' which returns 404 on the live Worker (27 console errors in audit). Guard registration in index.html: fetch(sw url,{method:'HEAD'}) first and register only if ok, with a silent .catch. Do not add routes to the backend. Add tests/ux/sw-register-guard.check.mjs asserting the guard code is present and registration is not unconditional. Frontend only, small change: preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL (dir=rtl, Cairo, existing colour tokens); backend frozen; no deploys; do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json or workflows.
